Hum kya banate aur lagate hain

Sab kuch aapke naap ke hisaab se banta hai, isliye aapki seedhi, balcony, kamre ya deewar mein bilkul sahi baithta hai.

Steel handrail aur fabrication

Seedhiyon, balcony, chhat aur passage ke liye mazboot aur sundar handrail. Design, banavat aur installation, sab hum karte hain.

  • Stainless steel (SS 304 aur 202) aur mild steel
  • Glass-steel, wooden-top aur designer pattern
  • Gate, grill aur balcony safety rail aapke naap ke anusaar

Aluminium door, window aur sliding system

Halke, lambe samay tak chalne wale aur lagbhag zero maintenance. Ghar mein roshni aur modern look laate hain.

  • Smooth sliding window aur door jo jagah bachate hain
  • Casement window, partition aur ventilator
  • Clear, frosted, tinted ya toughened glass
  • Na zang, na tedha hona; saaf karna aasaan; achhi sound aur heat insulation

Decorative lights

Hanging light, wall light aur festival lights jo har kamre ko garam aur sundar banate hain. Har kamre ke liye sahi light chunne mein hum madad karte hain aur saaf-suthri fitting karte hain.

PVC wall panel aur ceiling

Saadi deewaron aur ceiling ko dein saaf aur finished look. Hum drawing room, bedroom, pooja room, dukaan aur office ke liye PVC panel supply aur fit karte hain.

  • Seelan aur paani se surakshit
  • Deemak-proof
  • Pochhkar saaf karna aasaan
  • Tezi se fitting, kam gandagi
Panel ke designs mangwayein

Fluted wall panel

TV wall, bedroom backdrop aur entrance ke liye khadi dhaariyon wale panel. Grooves se gehraai aur halki shadow lines aati hain.

PVC wall panel

Wood-grain, marble-look aur plain designs, kai rangon mein, poori deewar ya accent wall ke liye.

PVC ceiling panel

Halke panel jo oonchi-neechi ceiling aur wiring chhupate hain, smooth aur barabar finish ke saath.

UV marble sheet

Chamakdaar marble-look sheet, feature wall, pooja room aur dukaan ke saamne ke liye.

Lighting ke saath feature wall

Panel ke saath LED strip aur decorative lights, ek garam aur poora finished backdrop ke liye.

Profile aur trim

Milte-julte corner, edge aur joint profile, taaki har jodh saaf dikhe.

Hamare kaam ki aur jhalkiyan

Glass, steel aur light, poori lagan se banaye aur lagaye gaye.
